strings.tierB.home.title: FieldSales: Puroguramu ya van sales n'abacuruzi
strings.tierB.home.description: Ahabw'abagabi: invoisi na risiiti aha simu y'omucuruzi, sitooka y'emotoka, okushorooza sente, emihanda n'okureeba abaguzi. Neekora hatariho intaneti.
strings.tierB.home.h1: Reeberera abacuruzi baawe kuruga aha kureeba omuguzi okw'okubanza okuhika aha kushorooza sente okw'aheruka
strings.tierB.home.definition: FieldSales n'orubuga rwa cloud ahabwa kampani z'okugaba ebintu n'eza wholesale ezirikukozesa abacuruzi abarikugyenda omu maduuka (sales reps). Abacuruzi nibahandiika kandi bakashohoza aha printa invoisi na risiiti barikukozesa esimu, bakareeberera sitooka eri omu motoka kandi bakahandiika abaguzi abu baareeba, kandi abakuru (ba maneja) nibareeba aho n'aho ebyaguzibwa, sente ezashoroozibwa n'amabanja g'abaguzi.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.title: Invoisi kuruga aha simu y'omucuruzi
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.line: Omucuruzi naahandiika invoisi ari aha rwiigi rw'omuguzi, kandi naagishohoza aha printa ya Bluetooth (thermal) atakarugire omu duuka.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.title: Okushorooza sente n'amabanja g'abaguzi
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.line: Buri kushashura nikuheebwa risiiti erimu namba, eyungirwe aha invoisi ezi erikushashura, kandi eibanja ry'omuguzi na ripooti ya akaunti ye nibihinduka aho n'aho.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.title: Obujunanizibwa aha sitooka y'emotoka
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.line: Sitooka ya buri motoka neereeberwa ekintu kimwe kimwe: ebyateekwamu, ebyaguzibwa, ebyagarurwa n'ebisigaire, kandi obutaingana nibureebeka eizooba eryo ryonyini.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.title: Emihanda n'okureeba abaguzi
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.line: Buri kureeba omuguzi nikuhandiikwa n'ekifo, eshaaha n'ebishushani, kandi omuhanda gwa buri mucuruzi nigworekwa aha maapu ahabw'omukuru.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.title: Neekora n'obu hatariho intaneti
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.line: Abacuruzi nibagumizamu kucuruza n'obu hatariho netiweeki. Ebihandiiko nibiguma omu simu, kandi intaneti yaagaruka nibyoherezibwa byonka, buri kimwe omurundi gumwe.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.title: Dashiboodi y'abakuru aha intaneti
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.line: Ebyaguzibwa, sente ezashoroozibwa, ebyagarurwa, sitooka n'oku buri mucuruzi arikukora omu mwanya gumwe. Buri mukozesa aine ebi arikwikirizibwa kukora.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.title: Tugambire oku murikucuruza
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.line: Saba quotation nari orukiiko. Nitureeba abacuruzi baanyu, emihanda, ebintu n'ebi murikwetenga aha invoisi.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.title: Tebeekanisa kampani yaawe
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.line: Teeramu ebintu, emihendo yabyo, abaguzi n'abacuruzi, kandi oteeke omu settings sente n'omushoro by'eihanga ryawe.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.title: Ohereze abacuruzi omu mihanda
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.line: Abacuruzi nibateeka app aha Android nari iPhone, bakateeka ebintu omu motoka, reero bakatandika kucuruza, kushohoza invoisi aha printa n'okushorooza sente.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.title: Reeberera eizooba nk'oku ririkugyenda
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.line: Dashiboodi y'aha intaneti neeyoreka ebyaguzibwa, sente ezashoroozibwa, sitooka y'emotoka n'abaguzi abareebirwe, abacuruzi bakiri omu mihanda.
strings.tierB.home.faq.0.a: FieldSales n'orubuga rwa cloud orw'okwebembera abacuruzi omu kampani z'okugaba ebintu n'eza wholesale. Neeshagika van sales (okucururiza omu motoka), route sales (okucururiza aha mihanda emanyirwe), pre-sales (okutwara oda ebintu bitakaheekirwe) na DSD (okuhikya ebintu omu duuka butereevu). Abacuruzi nibahandiika invoisi, bakazishohoza aha printa, bakashorooza sente kandi bakahandiika abaguzi abu baareeba, barikukozesa esimu, kandi abakuru nibareeberera ebyaguzibwa, sente ezashoroozibwa, sitooka y'emotoka n'amabanja g'abaguzi aha dashiboodi y'aha intaneti.
strings.tierB.home.faq.1.a: Eego. App y'omucuruzi neegumizamu kukora hatariho intaneti: omucuruzi naahandiika kandi naashohoza invoisi na risiiti, naahandiika abaguzi abu yaareeba kandi naayongyeramu abaguzi abahyaka, kandi byona nibyoherezibwa byonka, buri kimwe omurundi gumwe, intaneti yaagaruka. Hariho enshonga emwe ey'enjawuro omu Saudi Arabia: kampani ezirikukozesa okuyungwa na e-invoicing nizeetenga intaneti obu invoisi nari ey'ebyagarurwa erikuhandiikwa.
strings.tierB.home.faq.2.a: FieldSales neekora na kampani ezirikugaba ebintu omu mahanga goona. Buri kampani neeteeka sente zaayo n'omushoro omu settings zaayo, kandi invoisi, risiiti na ripooti nibibikozesa. FieldSales eine ekitebe kyayo omu Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, kandi okutandika nikukorwa aha intaneti, kurabira omu nkiiko, WhatsApp n'obuhwezi bw'ahare.
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.q: FieldSales neeyungwa aha nteekateeka za Gavumenti eza e-invoicing?
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.a: Nitushagika okuyungwa n'orubuga Fatoora orwa ZATCA omu ntambwe ya kabiri. Eki nikikwata aha kampani eziri omu Saudi Arabia. Omu mahanga agandi, harimu na Uganda, FieldSales neehandiika invoisi omu sente zaawe n'omushoro gwawe, kandi nikibaasika waakisaba kukuyunga aha nteekateeka y'eihanga eya e-invoicing, twamara kushwijuma naiwe ebi eihanga eryo ririkwenda. Aheru ya Saudi Arabia titurikuraganisa ngu invoisi niziija kuhikaana n'ebi buri ihanga ririkwenda.
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.q: App ya FieldSales eri omu ndimi ki?
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.a: Endabika ya app ya FieldSales (interface) eri omu ndimi ezi zonka: Oruharabu, Orungyereza, Orufaransa, Oruturuki n'Oruchaina. Teri omu Runyankore. Abacuruzi n'abakuru nibabaasa kuhindura orurimi rw'endabika, kandi invoisi ezishohoziibwe aha printa nizibaasa kuhandiikwamu orurimi rwa kabiri ahamwe n'orurimi orukuru. Empapura z'orubuga omu ndimi ezindi, harimu n'orupapura oru orw'Orunyankore, zaahindurwa ahabw'okumanyisa ebya FieldSales bwonka.
strings.tierB.home.faq.5.a: Saba quotation, saba orukiiko nari otuhandiikire aha WhatsApp. Nitwega oku abacuruzi baawe barikukora, reero nitukuhwera kuteeramu ebintu, emihendo yabyo, abaguzi n'abacuruzi. Abacuruzi nibateeka app aha Android nari iPhone, kandi abakuru nibakozesa dashiboodi omu browser yoona. Ebikozesibwa byonka ebi orikwetenga ni esimu za smartphone.
strings.tierB.home.uiLanguagesNote: Endabika ya app ya FieldSales eri omu ndimi ezi: Oruharabu, Orungyereza, Orufaransa, Oruturuki n'Oruchaina. Teri omu Runyankore. Empapura omu ndimi ezindi nizishoboorora FieldSales ahabw'okumanyisa bwonka.
strings.tierB.category.title: Puroguramu ya van sales ahabw'abagabi | FieldSales
strings.tierB.category.description: Puroguramu ya van sales: invoisi ezishohozibwa kuruga aha simu, sitooka ya buri kintu, okushorooza sente n'okureeba abaguzi. Neekora hatariho intaneti.
strings.tierB.category.h1: Puroguramu ya van sales (okucururiza omu motoka) ahabw'abagabi b'ebintu n'abacuruzi ba wholesale
strings.tierB.category.intro: FieldSales ni puroguramu ya van sales ahabwa kampani eziine abacuruzi abarikucururiza omu motoka aha mihanda buri izooba. Omucuruzi naateeka ebintu omu motoka, naacuruza aha buri duuka, naashohoza invoisi aha printa, naashorooza sente kandi naahandiika ebyagarurwa arikukozesa app emwe aha simu. Omukuru naareeba ebyateekwa omu motoka, ebyaguzibwa, sente ezashoroozibwa n'ebisigaire omu buri motoka.
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.title: Puroguramu ya van sales n'enki?
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.body: Puroguramu ya van sales, erikwetwa kandi cash van nari route sales, neebembera omuringo gw'okucuruza ogu: omucuruzi naatwara ebintu omu motoka, akaguza, akabihikya, akahandiika invoisi kandi akashorooza sente omu kuhika kumwe. Ekozesibwa omu mwanya gw'ebitabo bya invoisi eby'empapura n'okuteera esimu orweigoro. Neehandiika buri kuguza, buri kushashura na buri kintu ekyagarurwa nk'ekihandiiko, sitooka na sente bikabaasa kugyereranisibwa eizooba eryo ryonyini. Ahabw'omukuru, neegarukamu ebibuuzo bishatu buri rweigoro: buri mucuruzi yaaguza ki, yaashorooza sente zingahi, kandi niki ekikiri omu buri motoka.
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.title: Eizooba rimwe omu mihanda
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.body: Eizooba niritandika n'okuteeka ebintu omu motoka kuruga omu sitoowa, kandi ebyateekwamu nibihandiikwa. Aha buri duuka, omucuruzi naatoorana omuguzi omu app, naayongyeramu ebintu kuruga aha rupapura rw'ebintu nari aha barcode, naahandiika invoisi kandi naagishohoza aha printa ya thermal. Okushashura nikuhandiikwa na risiiti, kandi buri kintu ekyagarurwa nikihandiikwa n'enshonga yaakyo. Orweigoro, ebisigaire omu motoka nibigarurwa omu sitoowa. Hagati y'entambwe ezi, omukuru naabaasa kureeberera ebyaguzibwa, sente ezashoroozibwa n'abaguzi abareebirwe na buri mucuruzi aha dashiboodi y'aha intaneti, atarikuteera muntu weena esimu.
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.title: Ekozirwe ahabw'ahantu ahari netiweeki nkye
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.body: Emihanda y'okugaba ebintu neehingura ahansi y'ebyombeko, omu bicweka ahu barikukorera ebintu (industrial areas) n'omu byaro ebiine netiweeki nkye. App y'omucuruzi eya FieldSales neebiika abaguzi, ebintu n'emihendo yabyo omu simu, omucuruzi akabaasa kuhandiika n'okushohoza ebihandiiko hatariho intaneti. Buri kihandiiko kiine namba yaakyo ey'enjawuro, n'ahabw'ekyo kihika aha seeva omurundi gumwe gwonka, n'obu kyakwoherezibwa emirundi mingi. Kampani za Saudi Arabia ezirikukozesa okuyungwa na e-invoicing nizeetenga intaneti obu invoisi n'ez'ebyagarurwa zirikuhandiikwa. Ahari kampani ezo, risiiti, okureeba abaguzi n'abaguzi abahyaka nibigumizamu kukora hatariho intaneti.
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.title: Okushorooza sente n'obujunanizibwa aha motoka
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.body: Sente ezirikutwarwa omu mihanda nizeetenga okureeberwa nka sitooka. Buri kushashura nikuheebwa risiiti erimu namba ebaasa kuyungwa aha invoisi ezi erikushashura, kandi eibanja ry'omuguzi nirihinduka aho n'aho. Sitooka y'emotoka neebarwa aha buri kintu: ebyateekwamu okwihamu ebyaguzibwa, okwongyeraho ebyagarurwa n'empinduka ezihandiikirwe, abakuru bakabaasa kugigyereranisa n'okubara kw'amaisho omucuruzi atakaitaahire. Ebyagarurwa nibibaasa kutaanwamu: ebya burijo, ebishiishiikaire nari eby'okuhinduranisa, kandi omukuru niwe arikucwamu yaaba nibigaruka omu sitooka y'emotoka ebaasa kuguzibwa.
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.title: Ekozirwe ahabw'oha?
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.body: FieldSales neehikaana n'abagabi n'abacuruzi ba wholesale ab'ebintu ebirikuguzibwa bwangu nk'ebyokurya, ebyokunywa, eby'okwogyesa n'eby'okwerabirira, na kampani yoona eine abacuruzi abarikuhika aha maduuka aha mihanda. Neeshagika van sales, oda za pre-sales na DSD (okuhikya ebintu omu duuka butereevu). Ti ERP ekora byona: neeyungwa aha nteekateeka yaawe ey'ebitabo by'esente (accounting) nari ERP kurabira omu API. Abakuru nibo barikucwamu eki buri mucuruzi arikwikirizibwa kukora, nk'okuha discount, okuguza ahansi y'omuhendo oguri aha rupapura rw'emihendo nari okwongyeraho abaguzi abahyaka.
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.q: Van sales na pre-sales nibitaana ki?
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.a: Omu van sales, omucuruzi naatwara ebintu, akabihikya, akahandiika invoisi kandi akashorooza sente omu kuhika kumwe. Omu pre-sales, omucuruzi naatwara oda, reero sitoowa ekazihikya bwanyima. FieldSales neeshagika emiringo yombi, kampani ekabaasa kukozesa cash van aha mihanda emwe n'okutwara oda aha mihanda egindi. Omu miringo yombi, invoisi, sente ezashoroozibwa n'amabanja g'abaguzi biri omu nteekateeka emwe, kandi abakuru nibabireebera hamwe omu ripooti.
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.a: FieldSales neeyoreka, aha buri kintu omu buri motoka, obwingi obwateekwamu, obwaguzibwa, obwagarurwa n'obusigaire. Gyereranisa obusigaire n'okubara kw'amaisho, handiika obutaingana nk'empinduka ehandiikirwe, reero ogarure ebisigaire omu sitoowa omu kikorwa kimwe. Emotoka neetandika eizooba erikukurataho eine akaunti ehikire kandi emanyirwe.
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.q: Omucuruzi wa van sales naayetenga ebikozesibwa ki?
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.a: Esimu ya smartphone, Android nari iPhone. Printa ya Bluetooth (thermal) ti ey'okuhambirizibwa, kwonka neehwera omucuruzi kuha omuguzi invoisi nari risiiti eshohoziibwe aha printa. FieldSales terikuguza bikozesibwa kandi terikwenda kika kya printa eky'enjawuro. Abakuru nibakozesa dashiboodi omu browser ya kompyuta nari esimu yoona.
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.q: FieldSales neebaasa kuyungwa aha nteekateeka yaitu ey'ebitabo by'esente?
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.a: Eego. FieldSales neeha API erikwikiriza enteekateeka yaawe ey'ebitabo by'esente (accounting) nari ERP kugabana n'orubuga amakuru g'abaguzi, ebintu, invoisi, risiiti n'okwimuka kwa sitooka. Ekibiina kyawe nari omukugu w'okuyunga enteekateeka nibo barikwombeka okuyunga oku, barikukozesa ebihandiiko ebirikushoboorora API.
strings.tierB.countries.title: FieldSales omu mahanga: sente, omushoro, e-invoicing
strings.tierB.countries.description: FieldSales neekora n'abagabi omu mahanga goona. Reeba sente, omushoro n'embeera ya e-invoicing eya buri ihanga omu taabule emwe.
strings.tierB.countries.intro: FieldSales neekora na kampani ezirikugaba ebintu omu mahanga goona. Buri kampani neetoorana eihanga ryayo, sente n'omushoro omu settings zaayo, kandi invoisi, risiiti na ripooti nibikuratira ebyo. Okuyungwa aha nteekateeka za Gavumenti eza e-invoicing nikukora omu Saudi Arabia yonka. Omu mahanga agandi goona nikibaasika waakisaba. Taabule eri ahansi neeyoreka, aha buri ihanga, sente ezirikukozesibwa, omushoro ogwa burijo aha kuguza nari VAT, kandi yaaba okuyungwa aha e-invoicing ya Gavumenti nikukora nari nikibaasika waakisaba.
strings.tierB.countries.einvoicingLive: Nitushagika okuyungwa n'orubuga Fatoora orwa ZATCA omu ntambwe ya kabiri
strings.tierB.countries.taxNote: Sente n'omushoro nibiteekwaho na buri kampani omu settings zaayo. Emishoro eri omu taabule egi n'ey'okuhabura kwonka kandi neebaasa kuhinduka; shwijuma ebiragiro ebiriho hati n'omuhabuzi waawe aha by'emishoro. Akarongo (—) nikamanyisa ngu tihariho mushoro gwa burijo oguhandiikirwe ahabw'eihanga eryo.
strings.tierB.about.title: Ebikwatiraine na FieldSales
strings.tierB.about.description: FieldSales neekora puroguramu za cloud ahabwa kampani ezirikugaba ebintu ezirikukozesa abacuruzi. Ekatandikwa omu 2026 omu Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
strings.tierB.about.body.0: FieldSales (eiziina omu Ruharabu: فيلد سيلز) n'orubuga rwa cloud ahabwa kampani z'okugaba ebintu n'eza wholesale ezirikukozesa abacuruzi abarikugyenda omu maduuka. FieldSales ekatandikwa omu 2026 kandi eine ekitebe kyayo omu Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Neekora na kampani omu mahanga goona, kandi sente n'omushoro bya buri ihanga nibiteekwa omu settings za kampani yonyini. Abaguzi baitu ni kampani ezirikuguza ebintu kandi zikabihikya kurabira omu bacuruzi abari omu mihanda: abagabi, abacuruzi ba wholesale na kampani ezirikukora ebintu eziine emotoka zaazo ez'okucuruza.
strings.tierB.about.body.1: Nitwombeka enteekateeka emwe ey'omurimo gwona ogw'omu mihanda: invoisi ezirikushohozibwa aha printa kuruga aha simu y'omucuruzi, risiiti n'amabanja g'abaguzi, obujunanizibwa aha sitooka y'emotoka, emihanda n'okureeba abaguzi ahamwe n'ekifo n'ebishushani, na dashiboodi y'aha intaneti ahabw'abakuru. App y'omucuruzi neekora aha Android na iPhone kandi neegumizamu kukora hatariho intaneti, reero neeyohereza ebihandiiko intaneti yaagaruka. Kampani nizibaasa kuyunga FieldSales aha nteekateeka zaazo ez'ebitabo by'esente nari ERP kurabira omu API, kandi amakuru g'omu mihanda tigarikwetenga kuhandiikwa kabiri.
strings.tierB.about.body.2: Nitushoboorora puroguramu nk'oku eri. Nitushagika okuyungwa n'orubuga Fatoora orwa ZATCA omu ntambwe ya kabiri. Omu mahanga agandi, nikibaasika waakisaba kuyunga FieldSales aha nteekateeka za Gavumenti. Endabika ya app eri omu ndimi ezi: Oruharabu, Orungyereza, Orufaransa, Oruturuki n'Oruchaina. Teri omu Runyankore. Kugamba naitwe, saba quotation, saba orukiiko nari otuhandiikire aha WhatsApp.
strings.tierB.contact.title: Gamba na FieldSales
strings.tierB.contact.description: Gamba n'ekibiina kya FieldSales: saba quotation, saba orukiiko nari otuhandiikire aha WhatsApp ahabwa puroguramu ya van sales.
strings.tierB.contact.intro: Tugambire oku abacuruzi baawe barikucuruza hati n'eki orikwenda kuhindura. Saba quotation, saba orukiiko nari otuhandiikire aha WhatsApp, kandi omwe aha kibiina kyaitu naija kukugarukamu. Ahabw'obuhwezi, abaguzi baitu abariho nibabaasa kukozesa emiringo egyo nyini. Nikituhwera waatugambira eihanga ryawe, omubaro gw'abacuruzi, kandi yaaba nibacururiza omu motoka, nibatwara oda, nari byombi.
strings.tierB.contact.meetingIntro: Saba orukiiko aha intaneti n'ekibiina kyaitu. Nituija kukworeka eizooba ry'omucuruzi omu app na dashiboodi y'omukuru, turikukozesa eby'okureeberaho ebiri haihi n'ebintu byawe n'emihanda yaawe, kandi tukagarukamu ebibuuzo byawe ebikwatiraine n'okutandika.
